notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Although, it comes with a little delay, we are proud to announce the Release of the Multiplayer Update for Grocket. It took us a while, but now we are here and you can now connect with friends and people around the world. Here are the new features waiting for you:

Features

Game Modes
In the new Multiplayer Games you can compete in four modes:

 Deathmatch
 Survival
 Flags
 Race

Every mode comes along with different challenges and ways to play all together.


New Shooting System
To compete and fight against others, we created a new shooting system with lasers, bullets and beams, bringing the competition and skill level in Grocket on another level.


Powerups
During your matches you can collect Powerups, helping you to gain advantages over your opponents and to win the games.

 Shield
 Energy
 Heart
 Beam



New Skins, Boosts and Explosions
Winning or playing Multiplayer Matches will make you unlock new customizations in the shop, getting a fresh nicer look. Hope, your opponents won't give up for free though.


Reworked Profile Panel & Titel Screen
The Update brings a brand-new Profile System to the Game. Easy, clean and fresh. The Stats are sorted in Groups and the Profile Button is more centralized focusing more on the Stats of each Player. These Stats are also shown in Multiplayer, where you can battle with your friends for more kills.


Donator Leaderboard
Yes. Now everyone can finally see the Player who support us the most. We hope you enjoy it:)


New Tags, Stats & Achievements
For Multiplayer new Stats and Achievements are coming to the Game, wich also unlock new Skins and more customizations.


Mac Support
We are happy to finally support our gamer friends on MacOS with the new Update. 


Tons of Bugfixes
As always, we did our best to fix all bugs noticed, but you all know the game and of course we will try our best, to fix new bugs. So, feel free to report them to us.

notes.title: Multiplayer on 2nd of July
notes.content:
The Update

After a lot of work and a long time without any updates, we are thrilled to share some information about the upcoming multiplayer update with you. It will include the option to play with and fight against your friends in four different game modes:

 Deathmatch
 Race 
 Capture the Flag. 
Survival

Shooting Module & Power Ups
Multiplayer is also coming with a brand-new shooting system for the rockets, as well as different power ups to gain advantages over your opponents.


The wait will be worth it ;)

notes.title: Update to Version v.1.1.2 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
In this update, we fixed major bugs including:


 broken star times
 visual glitches in Gravityfields
 lasers and other level components
 leaderboard issues
 weird/broken storymode- coop- and freeplay levels
 pause menu bugs


We hope you enjoy the update. 
Feel free, to give feedback and further ideas.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.1 - Storymode level 33
notes.content: This small patch fixes the storymode level 33 which previously wasn't completable.

notes.title: Update v1.1 - Custom Controls
notes.content:
We finally implemented the ability to change your control bindings. You can simply do so in the main menu under Options->Controls

In addition, we made some minor and major bug-fixes:


level 32 not completable
level 60 camera upside down
leaderboards initially not loading
stats display mixed up
titlescreen music not looping

notes.title: Full Release
notes.content:
Big Update & end of Early Access

With leaving the early access, we are publishing a big update to our first big version of the game. 
Here are the main features:


 New chapter for the Storymode
 A new unlock system
 Profile panels and new stats
 Custom Player titles
 New Achievements
 Improved Scoreboard
 Major Bug Fixes and Improvements


h2]
Closer look on the changes:

New Storymode Chapter
The final Chapter called Motion brings new Levels and challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/9b66326370db5d42ae09df8163cbb7a063e60111.png

Profile Panels
New and old stats are now accessible in the improved Profile panel, in addition to Custom Player titles which you can unlock by beating the boss levels. The Profile panel will be especially important in preparation for the Multiplayer update in the future. That way, you will be able to compare your progress with friends and challenge each other. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/0214132cbcf665a81f478c2e59727478e49ba2df.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/8dc89be0a9811caa40a4398b2346d6652ffa0761.png

New unlock system
A new way to unlock Levels is coming to the game. Use keys if you are stuck and want to get to the next level. You can buy these keys with coins in the shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/6ff0a0e7a4eec4aaf607aa59e4a5ec204f5bf917.png

Along with new Achievements, we did major Bug Fixes to improve the game and your experience. 



The global Scoreboard is finally fixed and improved, since it now works based on the amount of collected stars of a user.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/a43642a3a41625d4bbccb36d2d47d901f58b1495.png


Bug Fixes

 Global leaderbord fixed
 Performance improvements
 Bugs of level buttons
 Button hover fails fixed
 Sound system updated
 Tons of small improvements




We hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think.

notes.title: Update to v0.3 - The first real update
notes.content:
Our first larger update, including:


 Support for Linux-based operating systems
 Remote Play Together support
 New global Leaderboard for all Levels at once:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/8e19104fab81f9991c01de02c2abac9d95d2a67b.png

 More Music which is separated into two genres: "Action" and "Chill"
 Improved startup performance (startup time reduced from more than a minute to about 10-15 seconds)
 New Main Menu:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653836/cd20d69b001379dc9cde6940667cff300da04e25.png

 Major and minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update to v0.2.3 - Fixed Stars
notes.content: Until now, the stars had a bug so that everyone had 0 stars. Now stars work again and are shown in the main menu, shop, star-path and in the level overview appropriately.

notes.title: Update to v0.2.2 - Small bug fix
notes.content: Levels are now locked by default and get unlocked after loading the player's high scores.

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.1
notes.content:
Fixed high score rounding bug (high scores were accidentally rounded down to the second) 
Improved leaderboard in level overview
